tools.name: catia_add_component
tools.description: Add an existing CATPart or CATProduct file as a component in the active assembly. The component is inserted at the origin.

tools.name: catia_add_new_part
tools.description: Create a new empty Part directly inside the active assembly. Returns the name of the created component.

tools.name: catia_angle_constraint
tools.description: Create an Angle constraint between two exact selected assembly supports.

tools.name: catia_chamfer
tools.description: Chamfer the one edge currently selected in CATIA using length+angle mode. Edge names and stale selections are unsupported.

tools.name: catia_circ_pattern
tools.description: Pattern an explicitly named feature around a selected point and selected linear axis. Counts include source; default is a closed ring.

tools.name: catia_close_document
tools.description: Close the active CATIA document without saving; save=true is rejected.

tools.name: catia_close_sketch
tools.description: Close the active sketch and return to Part Design. Must be called after finishing sketch geometry before applying 3D features.

tools.name: catia_coincidence_constraint
tools.description: Constrain two currently selected exact assembly supports in selection order. Each selected support must belong to the named component; names do not resolve face or plane references.

tools.name: catia_connect
tools.description: Connect to CATIA V5. Attaches to a running instance or launches a new one. Must be called before any other CATIA tool.

tools.name: catia_create_sketch
tools.description: Create a new 2D sketch on a reference plane (xy, yz, or zx). The sketch is opened for editing. You must close it with catia_close_sketch before creating 3D features.

tools.name: catia_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from CATIA V5 (does not close CATIA).

tools.name: catia_draft
tools.description: Draft is unavailable until a selected face, neutral plane, pulling vector and all CATIA mode arguments can be validated. No model change is made.

tools.name: catia_export
tools.description: Export the active document to a file. Supported formats: STEP (.stp), IGES (.igs), STL (.stl), 3DXML (.3dxml), VRML (.wrl), PDF (2D drawings).

tools.name: catia_fillet
tools.description: Fillet the one edge currently selected in CATIA. Selection is read immediately and is not a persistent edge ID. Edge names are unsupported.

tools.name: catia_fit_all
tools.description: Fit all geometry in the current 3D view (zoom to fit).

tools.name: catia_fix_constraint
tools.description: Fix the one currently selected assembly instance in place. Selection must be the component Product itself, not a face or feature.

tools.name: catia_get_active_document_info
tools.description: Get detailed info about the active CATIA document: name, type, path, part bodies, features, etc.

tools.name: catia_get_bounding_box
tools.description: Report that exact active-part AABB measurement is not yet supported. No fake min/max coordinates are returned.

tools.name: catia_get_inertia
tools.description: Read MainBody volume and area in SI units; optional mass uses a supplied uniform density. An inertia tensor is reported only when available and scope-compatible.

tools.name: catia_get_model_state
tools.description: Read the active document, bodies/sketches/features or components, parameters, and the current selection. This is not geometry verification.

tools.name: catia_get_parameters
tools.description: List all user-defined and computed parameters of the active part. Includes dimensions, formulas, and design tables.

tools.name: catia_get_selection
tools.description: Read the current CATIA selection: count, available element types/names, and document context. Names and positions are not stable face/edge IDs.

tools.name: catia_groove
tools.description: Create a Groove (revolution cut). Removes material by revolving a 2D profile around an axis.

tools.name: catia_gsd_blend
tools.description: Create a Blend surface connecting two curves.

tools.name: catia_gsd_circle
tools.description: Create a full 3D circle from a center point, a support plane, and a radius. Useful as a section for multi-sections surfaces.

tools.name: catia_gsd_close_surface
tools.description: Turn a closed (watertight) surface into a SOLID (Part Design CloseSurface). The solid is created in the active body.

tools.name: catia_gsd_create_geoset
tools.description: Create a new Geometrical Set (HybridBody) in the active Part and make it the active target for subsequent GSD elements.

tools.name: catia_gsd_extrude
tools.description: Extrude a profile (curve/sketch) into a surface along a direction vector. limit1/limit2 are the extents on each side (mm).

tools.name: catia_gsd_fill
tools.description: Create a Fill surface bounded by a closed contour of curves (one closed curve or several connected curves).

tools.name: catia_gsd_intersection
tools.description: Create the intersection of two elements (e.g. surface ∩ plane).

tools.name: catia_gsd_join
tools.description: Join (assemble) two or more curves or surfaces into one element.

tools.name: catia_gsd_line
tools.description: Create a 3D line between two points. Each point is an existing element name or [x, y, z] coordinates.

tools.name: catia_gsd_list_elements
tools.description: List all geometrical sets with their wireframe/surface elements and sketches, plus sketches in solid bodies. Use this to find element names for other GSD tools.

tools.name: catia_gsd_multi_section_surface
tools.description: Create a Multi-sections Surface (loft) through 2+ section curves (sketches, circles, splines...), optionally following guide curves. Sections should be listed in order along the lofting direction.

tools.name: catia_gsd_offset_surface
tools.description: Create a surface offset from an existing surface.

tools.name: catia_gsd_plane_3points
tools.description: Create a plane through three points (element names or [x,y,z]).

tools.name: catia_gsd_plane_offset
tools.description: Create a plane offset from a reference plane. Reference is 'xy', 'yz', 'zx', or the name of an existing plane element.

tools.name: catia_gsd_point
tools.description: Create a 3D point at (x, y, z). Coordinates in mm.

tools.name: catia_gsd_project
tools.description: Project a curve/point onto a support surface or plane.

tools.name: catia_gsd_revolve
tools.description: Revolve a profile curve around an axis line to create a surface of revolution. The straight axis must lie in the profile plane. Pass a unique axis name or select one line and set axis_from_selection=true. Angles in degrees.

tools.name: catia_gsd_set_active_geoset
tools.description: Select which Geometrical Set receives subsequently created GSD elements.

tools.name: catia_gsd_spline
tools.description: Create a 3D spline through a list of points. Each point is an existing element name or [x, y, z] coordinates in mm.

tools.name: catia_gsd_split
tools.description: Split an element by a cutting element, keeping one side. Use orientation to flip which side is kept.

tools.name: catia_gsd_sweep
tools.description: Create a swept surface by sweeping a profile curve along a guide curve (explicit sweep).

tools.name: catia_gsd_symmetry
tools.description: Mirror an element about a plane ('xy', 'yz', 'zx', or plane name).

tools.name: catia_gsd_thick_surface
tools.description: Turn a surface into a SOLID by adding thickness (Part Design ThickSurface). The solid is created in the active body.

tools.name: catia_gsd_trim
tools.description: Mutually trim two elements, keeping one side of each. Use reverse flags to flip which sides are kept.

tools.name: catia_hole
tools.description: Create a simple flat-bottom Hole from a named positioning sketch containing exactly one user point. The sketch and direction must be checked against the target solid. Threading is unsupported.

tools.name: catia_list_components
tools.description: List all components in the active assembly/product with their names and positions.

tools.name: catia_list_constraints
tools.description: List all assembly constraints in the active product.

tools.name: catia_list_documents
tools.description: List all open documents in CATIA V5 with their types and paths.

tools.name: catia_list_edges
tools.description: Report the exact-topology limitation without changing the user's selection. Names or indices cannot target a particular edge reliably.

tools.name: catia_list_features
tools.description: List shapes in MainBody only; unknown COM types are reported honestly.

tools.name: catia_measure_distance
tools.description: Measure minimum distance between two uniquely named geometry elements in the active CATPart. CATIA's raw length unit needs Windows calibration; the result is not labelled mm until then. Search clears the current selection.

tools.name: catia_mirror
tools.description: Mirror the current MainBody about an origin plane. Mirroring one named feature is unsupported.

tools.name: catia_move_component
tools.description: Move a component by translation and/or rotation. Translation in mm, rotation in degrees.

tools.name: catia_new_part
tools.description: Create a new empty Part document in CATIA V5. A Part is used for single-body 3D modeling (sketches + features).

tools.name: catia_new_product
tools.description: Create a new empty Product (assembly) document in CATIA V5. A Product is used to assemble multiple Parts together.

tools.name: catia_offset_constraint
tools.description: Create an Offset constraint between two faces/planes of two components. Select both exact assembly supports in order before calling.

tools.name: catia_open_document
tools.description: Open an existing CATIA document from a file path (.CATPart, .CATProduct, .CATDrawing).

tools.name: catia_pad
tools.description: Create a Pad (extrusion) from the last sketch. Extrudes a 2D profile into a 3D solid along the normal to the sketch plane.

tools.name: catia_pocket
tools.description: Create a Pocket (cut extrusion) from the last sketch. Removes material by extruding a 2D profile inward.

tools.name: catia_rect_pattern
tools.description: Pattern an explicitly named feature. Select two linear direction supports in CATIA immediately before calling. Counts include source.

tools.name: catia_save_document
tools.description: Save As to an explicit path. Existing files require allow_overwrite=true. Never silently overwrite the active CATPart/CATProduct.

tools.name: catia_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current 3D view, save it, and return the image as MCP image content. Supports JPG, BMP, TIFF (CATIA V5 cannot capture PNG; a .png path is saved as .jpg instead). Pixel size follows the CATIA viewer.

tools.name: catia_set_parameter
tools.description: Set the value of a named parameter in the active part. Useful for parametric design modifications.

tools.name: catia_set_view
tools.description: Set the 3D view orientation. Standard views: front, back, top, bottom, left, right, isometric.

tools.name: catia_shaft
tools.description: Create a Shaft from a sketch. CATIA normally uses an axis inside the sketch. To override it, select one straight axis in CATIA and set axis_from_selection=true; the tool assigns its live Reference to RevoluteAxis.

tools.name: catia_shell
tools.description: Shell the active solid inward by removing the one face currently selected in CATIA; inner thickness=t, outer thickness=0. Face names are unsupported.

tools.name: catia_sketch_arc
tools.description: Draw a circular arc defined by center, radius, and start/end angles (degrees). Angles are measured counter-clockwise from the positive X axis.

tools.name: catia_sketch_centered_rectangle
tools.description: Draw a rectangle centered at (cx, cy) with given width and height. Coordinates and dimensions in mm.

tools.name: catia_sketch_circle
tools.description: Draw a circle in the active sketch. Coordinates and radius in mm.

tools.name: catia_sketch_constraint
tools.description: Add a dimensional or geometric constraint to the active sketch. Supported types: distance, radius, angle, coincidence, tangent, perpendicular, parallel, horizontal, vertical, fix. Refresh catia_sketch_get_geometry immediately before using indices; they are transient positions, not stable IDs. Radius needs a circle/arc. Distance with one element sets a line's length; with two it sets their separation. Angle needs two lines. Close the sketch and update the part after editing to check the solve.

tools.name: catia_sketch_get_geometry
tools.description: List all geometry elements in the active sketch with their indices and types.

tools.name: catia_sketch_line
tools.description: Draw a line in the active sketch from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2). Coordinates in mm.

tools.name: catia_sketch_point
tools.description: Create a point in the active sketch. Coordinates in mm.

tools.name: catia_sketch_rectangle
tools.description: Draw a rectangle in the active sketch defined by two opposite corners. Creates 4 lines forming a closed profile. Coordinates in mm.

tools.name: catia_sketch_spline
tools.description: Draw a spline through a list of control points. Each point is [x, y] in mm.

tools.name: catia_thickness
tools.description: Offset the one currently selected solid face; direction/sign still needs live CATIA validation. Face names are unsupported.

tools.name: catia_update_part
tools.description: Force update/rebuild of the active part. Recalculates all features.

tools.name: catia_update_selected_feature
tools.description: Update exactly one currently selected Part feature or sketch by its live CATIA COM object. Does not use a name or topology index, and does not save.
